description: Use for how-to questions, what a CIVIL NX input means, or a MIDAS API table's fields. For valid names (material grades, section shapes) use midas_library. Searches the MIDAS help centre (support.midasuser.com), live: the CIVIL NX and GEN NX online help (every dialog: what it does, where it is in the menus, each input), the MIDAS API (MAPI) JSON manual (every db/ table, its URI, methods, JSON schema and examples), FAQ, tutorials and release notes. Use it to answer how-to and what-does-this-input-mean questions, to check CIVIL NX behaviour before advising, and to find the JSON shape of a MAPI table. English articles. Also searches a support FAQ of about 11,000 answers to the questions engineers most often ask MIDAS support (errors, unexpected results, how-to), and returns the best ones complete under answers. Returns the matching articles (id, title, area, section, snippet, link); read one in full with midas_docs_read. Areas default to CIVIL NX help + API manual + FAQ + tutorials + support FAQ. Needs no model and no account.

areas.description: Where to search: civil (CIVIL NX online help), gen (GEN NX online help), api (MIDAS API (MAPI) JSON manual), faq (FAQ), tutorials (Tutorials), updates (Product updates / release notes), cim (CIM online help), excel (Excel Connector), grasshopper (Grasshopper API), support (support FAQ: answers from past MIDAS support replies), or all. Default: civil, api, faq, tutorials, support.

query.description: What to look for, in the manual's own words where possible, e.g. "composite section for construction stage", "moving load optimization", "db/STAG".

name: midas_docs_search
title: Search the MIDAS manuals
